# sloth

A minimalist terminal UI for the GitHub side of your repo: PRs, reviews, status checks, CI. Auto-detects the repo from your cwd. Amber-on-black, no chrome.

Designed to be fully complementary with [lazygit](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit) — sloth handles GitHub data, lazygit handles local git ops.

```
ejfox/coachartie  ·  4 open

▌ #138  +  fix prompt cache layer            ejfox     +203 -9   3h
  #135  ·  bump deps                         renovate   +12 -12  1d

  #138 — fix prompt cache layer
  by ejfox  ·  updated 3h ago
  labels  perf · cache

  checks   + test  + lint  x deploy-preview
  review   + jchen  ? sara
  files    7 changed    comments  3    merge  mergeable

  Refactor the cache layer to use the new opus-4.7 cache control format.
  Should reduce cache miss rate by ~40% based on local testing.

  j/k move  enter diff  o open  / filter  r refresh  ? help  q quit
```

## install

Requires `gh` (authed) and `git`.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ejfox/github-sloth ~/code/github-sloth
cd ~/code/github-sloth && cargo install --path .
```

Or symlink the release binary:

```sh
cargo build --release
ln -s "$PWD/target/release/sloth" ~/.local/bin/sloth
```

## use

```sh
cd any/github/repo
sloth
```

## keys

```
j/k        move
g/G        top / bottom
ctrl-d/u   page down / up
enter / d  view diff in $PAGER
o          open PR in browser
/          filter (title, author, #, label)
r          refresh
?          help
q / esc    quit
```

## why

`gh dash` is a workspace tool — it shows your PRs across every repo. Most TUIs in the space (`gh-lazy`, `ghui`, `blippy`) have too much chrome and don't auto-scope to cwd. lazygit nailed cwd-context for git, nothing did the same for GitHub. So: this.

## scope

In: PRs, review comments, status checks, CI runs, issues (eventually).
Out: anything operating on your local working tree — that's lazygit.

## license

MIT
